# temps_global_ip_access_rule (Resource)

Allows or blocks a client address or network for every app the Temps proxy serves and for the console. Temps refuses a block rule matching the address Terraform connects from unless `acknowledge_lockout` is `true`, and one broader than /8 (IPv4) or /16 (IPv6) unless `confirm_broad_range` is `true`.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `ip_access_control:read`, `ip_access_control:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_global_ip_access_rule" "scanner" {
  ip_address = "203.0.113.0/24"
  action     = "block"
  reason     = "Abusive scanner"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) What to do with matching clients. One of `allow`, `block`.
- `ip_address` (String) Address or CIDR network, for example `203.0.113.0/24`.

### Optional

- `acknowledge_lockout` (Boolean) Save a block rule even if it matches the address Terraform connects from. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `confirm_broad_range` (Boolean) Save a block rule broader than /8 (IPv4) or /16 (IPv6). Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `reason` (String) Why the rule exists.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>
terraform import temps_global_ip_access_rule.scanner 7
```
